scope: SAT quantifies over all subsets of the declared optional EDB catalog satisfying explicit constraints; all other EDB tuples are absent. Full recursive stratified programs are used, not a UCQ approximation. UNSAT is bounded equality, not all-domain or all-trace equivalence. Every SAT witness is replayed and deletion-shrunk in the TypeScript evaluator; --native adds a Souffle cross-check. Testing and reachable trace checks remain separate.
